note: System-wide settings that apply to every game, all the time, without game detection. Each value is a documented Windows setting, backed up before it is written and restored by 'Restore BAKA System Tuning'. No FPS, frame-time, or latency gain is claimed until measured on physical hardware.

devicePolicies.name: HwSchMode
devicePolicies.purpose: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling on supported GPUs and drivers (takes effect after restart)

devicePolicies.name: AllowGameDVR
devicePolicies.purpose: No background game recording for any game

devicePolicies.name: SystemResponsiveness
devicePolicies.purpose: Reserve less CPU for background multimedia tasks (Windows default 20)

devicePolicies.name: SFIO Priority
devicePolicies.purpose: MMCSS Games task storage I/O priority

devicePolicies.name: Background Only
devicePolicies.purpose: MMCSS Games task applies to the foreground game

devicePolicies.name: Win32PrioritySeparation
devicePolicies.purpose: Short, variable quantums with a 3x boost for the foreground app (the game) instead of the background (Windows default 2)

devicePolicies.name: PowerThrottlingOff
devicePolicies.purpose: Windows does not power-throttle games and their helper processes (EcoQoS) on AC power

devicePolicies.name: value
devicePolicies.purpose: Game DVR is also off through the MDM policy path Windows 11 checks

devicePolicies.name: MouseDataQueueSize
devicePolicies.purpose: Windows default mouse input buffer (explicit, restorable; guards against bad tweak tools)

userPolicies.name: AutoGameModeEnabled
userPolicies.purpose: Windows Game Mode on for every game

userPolicies.name: AllowAutoGameMode
userPolicies.purpose: Windows Game Mode on for every game

userPolicies.name: GameDVR_Enabled
userPolicies.purpose: No background capture while any game runs

userPolicies.name: AppCaptureEnabled
userPolicies.purpose: No background capture while any game runs

userPolicies.name: DirectXUserGlobalSettings
userPolicies.purpose: Windows 'Optimizations for windowed games' (flip-model for DX10/11 windowed/borderless) and 'Variable refresh rate' for games without native VRR support

userPolicies.name: GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode
userPolicies.purpose: Keep Windows fullscreen optimizations at the Windows default (fast Alt+Tab, flip-model)

userPolicies.name: Flags
userPolicies.purpose: Pressing Shift five times in a game no longer opens the Sticky Keys prompt

userPolicies.name: Flags
userPolicies.purpose: Holding Num Lock no longer opens the Toggle Keys prompt

userPolicies.name: Flags
userPolicies.purpose: Holding Shift for 8 seconds no longer opens the Filter Keys prompt mid-game

userPolicies.name: NOC_GLOBAL_SETTING_TOASTS_ENABLED
userPolicies.purpose: Notifications stay on; Windows Do Not Disturb hides them during fullscreen games

userPolicies.name: NOC_GLOBAL_SETTING_ALLOW_CRITICAL_TOASTS_ABOVE_LOCK
userPolicies.purpose: No toasts over the lock screen

userPolicies.name: MouseSpeed
userPolicies.purpose: Turn off 'Enhance pointer precision' so aim follows raw mouse movement
